items.title: German tourist wins payout after losing sun lounger race
items.title_zh: 德国游客输了日光休息比赛就赢
items.summary: A German tourist has won a payout of more than €900 (£850) after he was unable to secure a sun lounger due to other guests reserving them with towels.
